CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTRELATEDDIGITALACCOUNT_SED
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount 
AS(
    SELECT
    BSA.AccountCode
    ,BSA.OnlineID
    ,BSA.BNK_CODE
    ,BSAD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSA.INSERT_DTTM
    FROM BUSC.SED_ACCOUNTS_DELTA BSAD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.SED_ACCOUNTS BSA
    ON BSA.AccountCode = BSAD.AccountCode AND BSA.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount;



--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        ACCOUNTCODE
        ,ONLINEID
    )) HASHROW, ACCOUNTCODE, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CustomerAccountId
        ,OnlineId
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_DELTA
AS(
SELECT 
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ACCOUNTCODE, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.ACCOUNTCODE = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
CustomerAccountId = SRC.AccountCode
,OnlineId = SRC.OnlineID
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'SED'
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = SRC.BNK_CODE
,WORKFLOWID = 0
,TASKRUNID = 0
,INSERTDTTM = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount SRC ON SRC.AccountCode = TGT.CustomerAccountId;

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount
(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,OnlineId
    ,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
    ,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
    ,WORKFLOWID
    ,TASKRUNID
    ,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT 
AccountCode AS CustomerAccountId
,OnlineID AS OnlineId
,'SED' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount_DELTA;

END
